content.title: Short interest in Trump Media climbs after recent rally, S3 Partners says
content.summary: Short interest in U.S. President Donald Trump's social media company has jumped following ​a recent merger announcement, suggesting some traders ‌expect the stock to give back more of its recent gains, ‌according to financial data firm S3 Partners.  Shares of money-losing Trump Media & Technology Group are up over 30% since December 18, when it announced a $6 billion merger with ⁠Google-backed TAE Technologies.  Since ‍the merger announcement, short interest in Trump Media shares has climbed 31% to nearly 16 million shares, around the highest ​level since October, S3 Partners said in a ‌report on Friday.
